# Capability Matrix

| Capability | Sensitive | Admin (role) | Developer (role) | User (role) |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Notes

- Admin role satisfies all capabilities workspace-wide via `roleSatisfies`.
- Developer role has no implicit capabilities; requires MS-scoped permission grant per ADR-0019.
- User role satisfies `workspace.read` only.
- Explicit deny (permission.permission_denies) overrides any grant or role rule.
